notes:
| [Marvel's Spider‐Man 2](Marvels-Spider‐Man-2) | ✅ | DLSS, FSR3.1, XeSS |  |  |  |

| Last Tested Version | 0.9 |
| Filename | dxgi.dll |
| OS | Win 11 24H2 |
| GPU | RX 9070XT |
| Upscaler Inputs | DLSS, FSR3.1, XeSS |
| Settings | Dxgi = false for Intel/AMD as Spoofing is unnecessary DLSS-FG is unlocked already without Dxgi spoofing DLSS is locked without spoofing, but FSR/XeSS upscaling inputs work just fine, use them instead. |
| FG-Settings | FSR 3.1 FG → FSR-FG/XeFG DLSSG via SL → FSR-FG/XeFG |
| Known Issues | For AMD/Intel cards, using Ray Tracing while Spoofing crashes the game at startup Either avoid using RT when spoofing or disable spoofing by setting Dxgi=false in OptiScaler.ini and check FG-Settings above. Since 0.9, Opti is now automatically disabling Dxgi spoofing |
| Notes | When using DLSSG via SL make sure you actually enabled DLSSG in the game options as otherwise hudless will be missing |
| Reported By | TheRazerMD |
